description: This file contains unit tests for the quic::QuicCryptoServerConfig class and related components, testing server configuration, certificate compression, source address tokens, and config management logic.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerConfigTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing QuicCryptoServerConfig functionalities.

classes.name: SourceAddressTokenTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing source address token behaviors.

classes.name: CryptoServerConfigsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing server config management and primary config selection.

classes.name: ValidateCallback
classes.description: Callback class for handling validation results in tests.

methods.name: SetConfigs
methods.description: Sets server configurations with specified IDs, primary times, and priorities.

methods.description: Validates source address tokens against IP and config, optionally retrieving network parameters.
